update_contract: API-aware installer and patch metadata resolution; exact size and SHA-256 verification; same-root atomic replacement; stale runtime removal; frozen self-check; rollback; restart of the existing executable
installer_contract: stable Program Files install root; clean previous runtime; preserve Roaming user data and reuse the existing installation path
runtime_contract: flat onedir frozen runtime without _internal; source-shadow guard; dynamic-threshold notification, sound, print, import, resource, database, Roaming migration, and offscreen UI self-checks
source_contract: root-package editable Python source; deterministic source manifest; deep static/runtime verification; no generated output, cache, obsolete shell, server files, stale versions, transformation reports, or embedded credentials
code_signing_contract: SHA-256 Authenticode signatures with RFC 3161 timestamps are required before production publication
deployment_validation_contract: same-origin HTTPS metadata, API health/bootstrap, homepage version/package reference, installer size, and SHA-256 verification
